This is the one of the quests that allows access to all of the heroes at the end of Nightfall.  

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
*[[Master of Whispers]] not yet recruited as one of your [[hero]]es

===Objectives===
* Find the [[Whispers Adept|Adept of the Order of Whispers]] and deliver the Master's commands.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* [[Master of Whispers]] joins your party.

==Walkthrough==
Exit the [[Throne of Secrets]] and head to the [[Chantry of Secrets]].  Find the Whispers Adept by the statue of [[Grenth]] and talk to him.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Master of Whispers
:''"Ahai, «name».  I must apologize for all my manipulations.  While I have not been part of your group, I have been watching your operation; assisting behind the scenes as much as I can.  Now that we have achieved a large measure of success, I wish to come out of the shadows and work by your side.  I ask but one favor.  Can you carry a [[Gain Master of Whispers#Reward dialogue|message]] to my [[Whispers Adept|men]], telling them we were successful?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will deliver your message.  It's good to know you were an ally all along.
| decline = I didn't trust you before and I don't trust you now.  I'll pass.
| ask = Did you deliver that [[Gain Master of Whispers#Reward dialogue|message]] to my [[Whispers Adept|men]]?
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Whispers Adept
:''"It is good to hear from the Master. We had begun to worry about his safety. Now that we know the Order of Whispers is safe, we can begin to make plans to safeguard the future of all Elona. Evil never sleeps, and neither does the Order of Whispers."''
